critique.evidence: Reduced-motion behavior is correctly proven at all three viewports: the media query matches and the hero remains at opacity 1 with no transform. Tablet and mobile timing is mostly stable (16.87–17.28 ms average, 0 long-frame ratio), but desktop averages 22.36 ms with a 50 ms worst frame. More importantly, the measured mid-frame is effectively identical to the end-frame at every viewport—and exactly identical on mobile—so the evidence does not demonstrate a smooth, progressive transition from the untransformed start to the rotated, translated, 0.45-opacity end state.
critique.fix: Retune and remeasure the animation so the midpoint shows clear interpolation rather than the final state, while preserving the verified reduced-motion override. Profile the desktop transform/opacity sequence and reduce compositor or main-thread cost until average frame time is near 16.7 ms and spikes remain below roughly 33 ms.
